name: Magicka Dragonknight Solo / Duo
author: DeadxxSmile / ATTB Community Launch Bundle
summary: Pure-class flame brawler built around Molten Whip, layered class DoTs, Soul of Flame sustain, and two flexible ultimates.

concepts.title: Primary resource
concepts.text: Put normal attribute points into Magicka. The build still uses daggers because ESO damage scaling is hybrid.

concepts.title: Flame pressure
concepts.text: Layer Searing Claw, Disintegrating Dragonfire, Incinerate, and Blockade, then use Molten Whip while the effects run.

concepts.title: Solo sustain
concepts.text: Soul of Flame is the safety valve: use it as resources fall and when several enemies are grouped around you.

concepts.title: Ultimate choice
concepts.text: Use Take Flight for cheap burst or movement; use Standard of Might when a boss will remain inside it.

tips: Keep one skill from each native Dragonknight line on the active bar whenever XP lands until all three reach rank 50.
Join Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, and Undaunted early; train mount Speed every day.
Unlock all three armor lines by equipping three pieces of each weight once, then return to the build’s leveling mix.
Do not buy Destruction Staff Tri Focus for this setup; it can change blocking behavior with an Ice Staff and is not needed here.
Ring of the Pale Order blocks outside healing. Remove it when a duo partner or group healer needs to heal you.
The two listed Class Mastery choices require all three native class lines at rank 50. Subclassing disables Class Mastery.
Scribing abilities are optional progression gates. Use the named temporary class or weapon skill until the Grimoire and scripts are unlocked.
Do not refresh Searing Claw too early; its later ticks are the most valuable.
Standard of Might loses value when enemies move out of it, so Take Flight is often better in mobile fights.
